title: Heliacal 6/8: heliacal_pheno_ut + Yallop lunar crescent
description:
### Summary
Port `swe_heliacal_pheno_ut` (the per-instant visibility phenomena report) → `Ephemeris::heliacal_pheno_ut`, including the Yallop lunar-crescent machinery (WidthMoon, LengthMoon, qYallop), the interpolation helpers (crossing, x2min, funct2), and DeterTAV.

Read docs/codebase-map.md first. Do NOT read ../swisseph C source — docs/c-ref-heliacal-pheno.md is the source of truth. Two documented traps: (a) the C function's own header comment is STALE — darr[26] actually holds elongation (not CVA) and slots 28/29 are never written; trust the doc's slot table which was transcribed from the code, not the comment. (b) The Yallop grade table in this C checkout has SIX grades A–F with thresholds 0.216/-0.014/-0.16/-0.232/-0.293 (strict inequalities) — the catalogue-internal.md §15.5 five-grade summary is WRONG; follow pheno doc §1.

### Files
- `src/heliacal.rs` — crescent geometry + interpolation helpers + `DeterTAV` + `pub fn heliacal_pheno_ut(...)` + `HeliacalPheno` output struct.
- `src/context.rs` — `Ephemeris::heliacal_pheno_ut` delegate.
- `src/lib.rs` — re-export `HeliacalPheno`.
- `tests/c-gen/gen_heliacal.c` — extend with `"pheno"` key; regenerate heliacal.json.
- `tests/golden/heliacal.rs` — extend.

### Implementation steps
1. `width_moon`, `length_moon`, `q_yallop` per pheno doc §1 — exact formulas incl. the crescent-width geometry `W = 0.27245·π·(1+sin·sin)·(1−cos·cos)` shape as §1 spells it, and the full 6-grade q table with fall-through-to-0 boundary behavior. Note §5's trap: WidthMoon's parallax argument is computed independently (GeoAltO − AltO), NOT reused from pheno's attr[5] — port as §1/§4 specify.
2. `crossing`, `x2min`, `funct2` per §2 (linear crossing + parabola-minimum fitting).
3. `deter_tav(eph, dobs, jd_ut, dgeo, datm, object_name, epheflag, helflag) -> Result<f64, Error>` per §3 (builds on 5/8's topo_arc_visionis / 4/8's vis-lim core exactly as §3's call chain shows).
4. `HeliacalPheno` struct: 28 named f64 fields mapping darr[0..27] per §4's slot table (name them from the table's meanings: tc_altitude, tc_apparent_altitude, gc_altitude, azimuth, tc_sun_altitude, sun_azimuth, tav_act, arcv_act, daz_act, arcl_act, kact, minTAV, t_first_vr, t_best_vr, t_last_vr, t_bvr, t_first_ut, t_best_ut, t_last_ut, t_sunrise/... — use §4's exact per-slot semantics; slot 26 = elongation, slot 27 = object magnitude). Provide `pub fn as_array(&self) -> [f64; 28]` for test convenience (OrbitalElements precedent).
5. `pub fn heliacal_pheno_ut(eph, tjd_ut, dgeo, datm, dobs, object_name, event: HeliacalEventType, epheflag, helflag) -> Result<(HeliacalPheno, HeliacalFlags?), Error>` — full walkthrough per §4: default params, object/Sun/Moon geometry via 3/8's object_loc/azalt_cart, rise/set anchoring via rise_set, the Moon-branch (Yallop q + crescent width/length) vs non-Moon branch, TypeEvent-dependent slot population, which slots stay 0.0 in which branches, error paths. The dead `if((0))` block (§4 notes it would write darr[30] OOB) is NOT ported.
6. Delegate in context.rs (after heliacal_angle), lib.rs re-export.
7. Extend gen_heliacal.c `"pheno"` key (~15 cases): "moon" × TypeEvent=3 (evening first) at two known young-crescent evenings — 2005-04-09 ~17:30 UT and 2005-05-09 ~17:45 UT at Mecca dgeo [39.83,21.42,300.0]; "venus" × TypeEvent=1 (morning first) at 2453720.0 and TypeEvent=2 at 2453000.0, Cairo; "sirius" × TypeEvent=1 near its heliacal-rising season (2453586.0, early Aug 2005) Cairo; each also × one HIGH_PRECISION variant. Record retval + darr[0..27] (dump 28 values). SEFLG_SWIEPH, ephe path + star-name buffer per gen_eclipse.c pattern.
8. Regenerate heliacal.json; extend tests/golden/heliacal.rs: assert all 28 slots. Tolerances: instantaneous geometry slots eps 1e-7; the time-of-visibility slots (t_first/t_best/t_last families, per §4 these come from crossing/parabola fits over sampled curves) eps 1e-5 day.
9. Update docs/codebase-map.md heliacal entry.

### C reference
docs/c-ref-heliacal-pheno.md §1–§5 (call contracts into vision doc §7/§9 functions).

### Golden tests
- Same gen_heliacal build/run as 4/8–5/8.
- `cargo test --test golden heliacal -- --nocapture`.

### Acceptance criteria
- `cargo test --test golden heliacal -- --nocapture` passes (all keys incl. 4/8–5/8 after regeneration).
- `cargo test` full suite green; no new clippy warnings.

### Escape hatch
If golden tests fail with geometry errors > 1e-6 or time-slot errors > 1e-4 day after two debugging attempts, STOP and report failing cases/slots, actual vs expected, what you tried. Escalate to Opus.
execution_record: Implemented in two commits: (1) 6229ef7 — main implementation + bug fixes + golden tests; (2) 110620d — codebase-map update. Found and fixed two pre-existing bugs in heliacal.rs: object_loc angle=7 TOPOCTR ordering (geocentric altitude was incorrectly getting topocentric correction), and calc_rise_and_set SET+below-horizon day-anchoring interval was [tjd0-1,tjd0] instead of C's [tjd0,tjd0+1] (caused Jupiter to find previous day's set event). Both bugs were in code from sub-task 3/8 (swisseph-rs/106), never golden-tested before because vis_limit_mag doesn't exercise rise_set or angle=7 object_loc.
